title: The Kitten Who Was Afraid of the Dark: Nightlight Courage!

lines.text: Click! The bedroom lamp went out, and thick black shadows filled Whiskers' bedroom!
lines.caps: *CLICK! The lamp went out, | and thick black *SHADOWS | filled the *BEDROOM!

lines.text: In the corner stood a tall, spooky shape with giant waving tentacles!
lines.caps: In the corner stood a *TALL, | spooky shape with giant *WAVING | *ARMS!

lines.text: Whiskers pulled his fluffy blanket over his whiskers, shivering with fear!
lines.caps: Whiskers pulled his *BLANKET | over his ears, shivering with *TOTAL | *FEAR!

lines.text: Then his big brother whispered, Shadows can only copy what is already here!
lines.caps: Then his brother *WHISPERED, | Shadows can only copy what is *ALREADY | *HERE!

lines.text: Whiskers clicked his tiny yellow flashlight and beamed it straight at the monster!
lines.caps: Whiskers clicked his *FLASHLIGHT | and beamed it straight at the *SPOOKY | *MONSTER!

lines.text: Giggle! It wasn't a monster at all—just his yellow winter jacket and floppy hat!
lines.caps: *GIGGLE! It wasn't a monster— | just his winter jacket and *FLOPPY | *HAT!

lines.text: The dark doesn't create monsters; it just plays funny tricks with sleepy eyes!
lines.caps: The dark doesn't create *MONSTERS; | it just plays funny tricks with *SLEEPY | *EYES!

lines.text: Bravery is turning on your little light and seeing the truth for yourself!
lines.caps: Bravery is turning on your *LIGHT | and seeing the truth for *YOURSELF!

lines.text: Sleep peaceful and brave—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
